messages:
Sam: Hi team — picking up NorthBridge POC. Security wants SAML + SCIM + RBAC details. Sales asked for: SCIM delta window, SCIM rate limits, SAML attribute mapping, role provisioning path, domain ownership proof, and whether Hosted vs Dedicated changes identity flow. Also need a ballpark on pricing for hosted vs Dedicated commits. Can infra/product/ops chime in? @Priyanka @Elaine

Priyanka: SCIM notes: default delta_window = 15m (900s), can go down to 5m (300s) on Dedicated. Rate limit: 300 req/min/tenant for bulk sync; for POC we can raise to 600/min. Recommend batching for initial syncs. Will attach config snippet.

Priyanka: ```json
{
  "scim": {
    "delta_window_seconds": 900,
    "rate_limit_per_min": 300,
    "batching_recommended": true
  }
}
```

Elaine: RBAC: we support mapping from SAML assertion attribute ("roles") and group->role mappings via SCIM groups. We DO NOT auto-grant tenant-admin without an explicit mapping table. Example mapping: ProdAdmin -> admin, ReadOnly -> viewer. Delegated admin mode is opt-in and will enable extra audit logs.

Jordan: Hosted vs Dedicated: functionally both support SAML/OIDC + SCIM. Dedicated lets you set custom SCIM rate limits, private KMS for keys, and VPC restrictions which affect IdP health checks. For pricing: hosted is usage (tokens + embedding units) — POC quote: provide short free credits; Dedicated needs month commit — Sales to confirm exact band.

Ida: I'll prepare the security questionnaire answers. Quick on domain controls: we support DNS TXT verification for domains/subdomains, or SAML metadata ownership (signed metadata) for enterprise setups. Which does NorthBridge prefer?

Sam: They prefer DNS TXT verification for now. Also one question: if the SAML IdP is down, do we provide a fallback (magic link/email) for users to sign in? Need explicit answer for security QA.

Elaine: Yes — fallback via email OOB (magic link) is available for Hosted when enabled. For Dedicated, fallback is allowed but depends on network policy and customer's admin settings. We'll add an FAQ note: fallback is opt-in and logged.

Jordan: Action items: @Priyanka provide final SCIM delta/rate SLAs + sample config by EOD; @Elaine provide role-mapping example and formal statement on fallback; @Ida upload completed security questionnaire (answers + attachments); @Sam share expected user counts and group counts so infra can size rate limits.

Sam: User counts for initial POC: ~18k users, ~3k daily delta operations, initial group sync ~120 groups. I'll drop a sheet in the thread.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled for POC tenant on staging at 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC — no production impact.

Priyanka: Noted. For the POC tenant we'll set rate_limit_per_min = 600 and enable the SCIM batch endpoint. Sample SCIM patch we use for testing:```PATCH /scim/v2/Users
[ { "op": "replace", "path": "emails[0].value", "value": "user@example.com" } ]```

Sam: Perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
